summary: Form 6-K filed by VivoPower PLC on July 20, 2026, announcing the appointment of Syed Muhammad Nouman as Group Finance Director and Principal Financial and Accounting Officer. No transaction, tender, activist event, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a routine executive hire to strengthen the finance function as the company scales its AI data center business and progresses a subsidiary combination. No deal terms, premium, consideration, or regulatory milestones are provided. This is an ordinary current report of a management appointment, not a special situation.
